data.title: 萝丝 · 学院长椅上的质朴甜意
data.description: 学园林荫道木制长椅上，午后阳光透过树叶洒下斑驳光点。萝丝双手捧着希德赠予的粗粮面包，两颊泛红陷入浪漫脑补的幸福浅笑。
data.location: sunlit cobblestone academy garden avenue shaded by lush oak trees
data.action: sitting on park bench, holding half a rustic bread roll with both hands, blushing deeply while smiling dreamily into the distance
data.lighting: 树荫筛落的温暖阳光斑纹
data.promptProse: Rose sits on an academy courtyard bench cherishing a simple bread roll with flushed cheeks, smiling in an innocent romantic reverie.
data.animaCaption: Dappled sunbeams dance over her uniform as she cradles the bread happily.
